program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16, 10, 20),       # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),    # diff pair L
    "Itail": (40e-6, 20e-6, 100e-6),
    "gmidp": (10, 7, 14),        # PMOS mirror + second-stage device gm/Id
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "I7":    (300e-6, 150e-6, 420e-6),
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),    # NMOS bias mirrors L
    "gmidb": (13, 10, 16),       # high gm/Id -> low Vdsat for tail sink
    "Cc":    (3e-12, 1.5e-12, 6e-12),
    "kz":    (1.5, 0.8, 4.0),    # Rz = kz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    Itail, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = Itail / 2

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5)
    vtail = vcm - m1.vgs
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.9)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.9)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    m0 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], Itail, vds=max(vtail, 0.1))
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m0)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # diode side gate = inverting terminal (two inversions to vout otherwise)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("Rz", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * Cc + C1 * cl + Cc * cl) / (2 * PI)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    denom = Cc * (1.0 / m7.gm - Rz)
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * denom) if abs(denom) > 1e-30 else 1e15
    z_ph = math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(fz)))
    z_ph = z_ph if fz < 0 else -z_ph
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) + z_ph
    slew = min(Itail / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + Itail + I7)
    swing = vdd - m8.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "power": power, "swing": swing}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS input, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS output, Rz-Cc)

events.reason: Checker flagged the word 'input' in comments as forbidden. Removed it; two-stage Miller op-amp topology and first-order sizing look adequate (UGBW~16MHz, PM~65deg, SR~13V/us, P~0.63mW).

Input polarity was inverted (diode-side gate on vinp) causing positive feedback and railed output; swap gates. Tail sink M5 in triode: raise bias mirror gm/Id to cut Vdsat; derive tail headroom from v
